title: ranges do not chain
purpose: Invalid source is rejected before execution.

rejection.justification: The contract requires rejection but the grammar marks this rule as context-sensitive (checked after parsing); detection while parsing is equally conforming.

provenance.origin: authored for OCS 0.1.0 from the cited contract text
provenance.expected_basis: spec 8.6: chained ranges are forbidden; grammar range_expr allows one range operator.
